instruction: Add a new blank slide at the end of the presentation and save the file.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a new slide. Original presentation has 16 slides (verified by reading the file). After adding one, should have 17 slides.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification: Evaluator only checks slide count (17 total), but does not verify the new slide is at the END of the presentation
Missing requirement check: Evaluator does not verify the new slide is BLANK (could have content and still pass)
Weak coverage: Instruction has multiple specific requirements ('blank', 'at the end', 'save'), but evaluator only verifies total count increased by 1
False positive risk: Agent could add a slide with content at the beginning and pass this test (count would still be 17)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add check to verify the new slide is at position 16 (last index) by checking slide properties or comparing slide order
Add check to verify the last slide is blank by verifying it has no text content, no shapes (except placeholders), or no filled content
Consider using metric that checks: 1) slide count = 17, 2) slide at index 16 exists, 3) slide at index 16 has minimal/no content
Alternative: Check that slides 0-15 match original content and only slide 16 is new and blank
